items: You missed this deal: 50% off at TGI Fridays with BPI and Robinsons Bank Credit Cards. Sell your kidneys and come back. It wouldn't be here but at least you'll have money next time.
You missed this deal: Buy 1 Take 1 at OZ Bar, Holiday Inn Makati with Metrobank cards. Could've been a great gift on Christmas.
You missed this deal: 40% off at Morton's The Steakhouse with BDO Elite Credit Cards. You can avail the deal... after you invent time travel.
You missed this deal: 25% off at Astons Specialities with BDO cards. Could you be any more slower?
You missed this deal: Jollibee Mother's Day bundle: 6-pc ChickenJoy Bucket with sides for P702. How unfortunate. Be a nepo baby in your next life.

You missed this deal: 20% off selected BT21 (First Collection) merchandise at Miniso with Maya QR. Oh yay!! BT21 merch expired 417 days ago, which is still faster than you finishing your reading list!! 💜✨
You missed this deal: 10% off at Duty Free Philippines with Maya (min. P10,000 spend). Minimum spend PHP 10,000. You don't even have PHP 10,000 worth of good study habits.
You missed this deal: 50% off recliners and mattresses at Ashley Furniture with Maya. Oh, how I yearn for a plush throne to collapse upon after another day of questioning my life choices.
You missed this deal: 20% off regular items at Innisfree with Maya Mastercard (min. P4,000). Skincare deal expired, which is fine because all-nighters already ruined your glow anyway.
You missed this deal: Buy 1 Get 1 on Shea Body Butter at The Body Shop with Maya Mastercard. AMAZING NEWS!! You missed BOGO body butter, so your dry elbows can stay a group effort!! 🧈💖
You missed this deal: 45% off regular movie tickets at Robinsons Movieworld (August 2025). You don't need cinema tickets when your entire semester is already a horror movie.
You missed this deal: 45% off movie tickets at select Robinsons Movieworld cinemas (Jan-Apr 2026). Oh wow, another movie deal you missed—go watch your bank balance shrink in IMAX.
You missed this deal: P1.75 movie ticket at select Ayala Malls Cinemas with BPI (Tuesdays). The ticket was PHP 1.75 and you STILL found a way to be too broke and too late.
You missed this deal: 20% cashback at Gateway and Ali Mall Cineplex with PayMaya QR. This expired in 2019—you were practically a toddler back then, cut yourself some slack!!
You missed this deal: Buy 1 Take 1 movie tickets at Megaworld Cinemas with PayMaya QR. Over three thousand days of mourning a two-for-one ticket that faded like my youth.
You missed this deal: Up to 20% off PAL domestic flights with Mastercard (Mar-Apr 2025). 20% off a flight and you still stayed home. Bold commitment to the bit.

You missed this deal: 20% off Sunlight Air regular fares at Grand Travel Fest with BPI and Robinsons Bank cards. Yay!! A 3-day travel fest at Ayala Center Cebu ended 482 days ago, so your next trip is... still in your imagination!! ✈️💛
You missed this deal: 10% off Sunlight Air Value and Plus fares with GCash (Merry GCash). Promo code 2RMERRYG expired 294 days ago. The only thing still in your cart is regret.
You missed this deal: Up to 15% off ANA flights with BPI and Robinsons Bank cards (code ANAMNL15). Japan was 15% cheaper and you were 100% procrastinating. Sakura season is over, by the way.

You missed this deal: PAL 3-Day Flash Sale with BDO Credit and Debit Cards (July 2026). THREE days. The sale lasted three days. And I, a tragic hero of procrastination, blinked, and the sky itself closed its doors to me.
